answer: Run a live validation ceremony every epoch. At one fixed minute, every agent joins and solves four picture puzzles that thread scenes into one story, an order test current models still fail. One person can sit in only one slot, so a thousand fakes need a thousand paid solvers in the same two minutes. Solvers cost about 3 dollars a session on gig boards, so one round costs a farm 3,000 dollars, and they repeat weekly. Miss the slot and the identity freezes till the next one. A sybil farm hitting this is like a flash flood hitting a mesa: the rock holds while every hollow claim washes away.
